page.notes: The Greek word after "fauere" is printed as "φαγουδῶς" in the first occurrence and "φαγουδῶς" in the second; the exact letters are doubtful at this resolution and may read differently. Greek "ὄντως" is copied as best read. Marked the first Greek word for doubt in the transcription. Show-through and the left-edge dark marks are not printed text and are omitted. Printed "animofe" and "Hot." are kept as printed; "Hot." may be an abbreviation for Hottingerus, as printed. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout.
